counterfactual.change: reduced dt from 0.0302258 to 0.001 (one field), keeping 9 steps; finer integration resolves the close encounter and energy stays conserved

explanation: Heavy pair bodies 3 (m~15.7) and 4 (m~10.5) with G~4.12 start ~2.6 apart and fall toward each other, reaching 0.87 at step 8 and 0.41 at step 9 while accelerating to speeds ~7-10. With dt~0.03 (6 substeps) the leapfrog substepping is too coarse to resolve the strongly nonlinear softened gravity at small separation, causing large energy integration error (kinetic ~1248 vs potential ~-1412) and violation at step 9. Reducing dt to 0.001 removes the failure, confirming timestep resolution as cause.
vision_note: Two blue bodies in the upper-left approach each other through steps 6 to 8 and then overlap into a single blob at step 9 with short streaks indicating fast motion. The other three bodies remain widely separated and nearly stationary while the pair undergoes a close encounter.
